name: acid-squares

frames.best_why: The full field of glossy pink and blue beveled tiles is visible; frame 1 is black and frame 2 shows only two tiles.

tagline: Glossy beveled tiles ripple in pink and blue and dent under the cursor.
summary: A full-bleed WebGL field of rounded square tiles with glassy bevels, lit pink and blue on black. The surface breathes in slow waves, dents beneath the pointer and sends a pulse across the grid when clicked.
appearance: A tight grid of thick, rounded square tiles tilted away from the viewer, each with a glossy bevel catching pink and blue light against near-black gaps. Colour shifts across the field from cool blue at the left edge to magenta at the right.
behaviour: The whole surface rises and falls in slow waves, and the tiles reveal themselves in a staggered intro. The pointer dents the tiles under it, and a click sends a bright pulse ripple across the grid.
use_when: A launch or product page wants a loud, tactile animated backdrop that reacts to the pointer.
avoid_when: A continuously animating WebGL canvas can overwhelm copy and drain mobile batteries.
customise: Dozens of props tune colours, tile size, gap, roundness, bevel, gloss, waves, speed, lighting, tilt, grain, hover and pulse; the shader shape and mesh detail stay fixed.
weight_why: Runs a WebGL2 mesh and fragment shader every frame across the whole viewport.

a11y.note: The decorative canvas is hidden from assistive tech and reduced-motion stops the waves, but the click pulse has no keyboard path.

issues: The first frame is entirely black before the staggered intro reveal.
polish_why: Rich, tactile shader with convincing bevels; the black opening frame and dense shine hurt clarity.
